tour.title: What we will show you
tour.lead: These are screens from the product, not mock-ups. We run them live at the stand, on the vertical and markets you pick above.

rows.h: Your bots and your browser agent, in one thread
rows.p: DogClaw sets the TikTok campaign up in a real browser: objective, GEO, age band, daily budget. CreativeBot proposes 9:16 variants. The ads bot reports ROAS, cost per result and CPA. Same channel, same conversation.
rows.alt: Cluega Casino Delivery Team channel with DogClaw, CreativeBot and the TikTok Ads bot working on one campaign

rows.h: Every creative carries its own cost per lead
rows.p: Slots, live casino, sports betting and blackjack creatives ranked by what a valid lead actually costs. Each card is marked Winner, Stable, Watch or Critical, with spend and impressions attached.
rows.alt: Cluega iGaming marketing dashboard with spend, leads, deposit rate, ROI and six creatives ranked by cost per lead

rows.h: Runs on the accounts you already have
rows.p: TikTok Ads, Meta, Google Ads, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube authorize from one page. DogClaw runs browser tasks in your own Chrome or on its cloud browser: nothing is rebuilt, nothing is exported by hand.
rows.alt: Cluega app authorization page connecting TikTok Ads, Meta, Google Ads, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube
